title: Final Countdown to Midterm Elections, Tech Stocks Tank
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Lisa Mateo and Nathan Hager bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Medical Historian and “Sleuth-Hound” Author Lindsey Fitzharris, European Commission Vice-President and Fmr. PM of Estonia Kaja Kallas, Writer & Journalist Benton Graham, NY Rep. Gregory Meeks and Journalist and Bioethicist Elizabeth Yuko. (Source: Bloomberg)
